items.title: Blo Blow Dry Bar East Greenwich -- Mind Games Team Building Program
items.summary: I never imagined that we would be offering one of our Education By Entertainment Mind Games programs for hair stylists in a hair salon... but we did on September 10, 2026 and it was an amazing success!!!The hair stylists described these activities as:* FUN* Amazing* Awesome* Educational* Interactive* Wonderful* UniqueHighlights of the program included the "Blindfolded Beanie Baby Walk" and "Our Colleague Game" which you will see looking through the attached photo album.Education By Entertainment programs are designed to show people more about how they think through interactive "discovery" activities. They are perfect for businesses, conferences, conventions, schools, and social events.  Our programs are appropriate for everyone from professionals to third graders.We put the FUN into FUNdraisers!!!We LOVE birthdays!Key Words: Hair Stylists, FUN, Team Building, Cognitive Psychology, Leadership Development, Interactive Learning, Career Development, Dr. Ronald G. Shapiro.
